liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Suite includes Cryptical Envelopment, Drums, space jams, and Me And My Uncle; Performance has significant energy [8][13]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Song was extremely climactic at the end [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-12-01.sbd-set2.miller.32304.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 11 songs; 66 min; rated 5/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard recording from the Boston Music Hall, December 1, 1971 [4]
- **gd1971-12-01.partial-set2-matrix.vernon.83164.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 8 songs; 44 min; rated 4.11/5 by 18 [3]. Said about its sound: Partial show containing forty-five minutes of music; Significant portion of space playing with great sound from the board; Audience energy builds during The Other One; jams are tight and ethereal [5][6][7][15]
- **gd1971-12-01.sbd.set2.fixed.miller.76424.flac16**: soundboard; 11 songs; 66 min; rated 2.8/5 by 5 [2]

## Around the show

- Performance was broadcast live on WBCN radio [10]
- Recording location is on the Phil side of the venue [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-12-01.sbd-set2.miller.32304.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Reel Master -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD -> EAC -> FLAC [1]
- **gd1971-12-01.partial-set2-matrix.vernon.83164.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Matrix by Matt Vernon; source: Matrix - see info file [3]. Also: Matrix composed of soundboard and speed-adjusted audience recording using Cool Edit Pro [3]
- **gd1971-12-01.sbd.set2.fixed.miller.76424.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD -> EAC -> FLAC [2]
